Management Plan
- Advice for acute diarrhea: maintain hydration; obtain oral rehydration salts (e.g., Dioralyte) OTC to replace fluids/electrolytes; adopt a “soft” diet (easily digestible foods such as crackers, toast, jam; avoid dairy, meat, fish, and eggs initially); yogurt/probiotics acceptable to help restore gut flora; once symptom-free for approximately 48 hours, gradually reintroduce vegetables, then meat/eggs/fish. Red flags and safety-netting: seek care if frequency increases to 6–8+ times/day, signs of dehydration, blood in stool, or if symptoms persist beyond one week. Return if worsening or concerns.

- Pathology tests as above: Stool studies if persistent symptoms >1 week or blood in stool—discussed.
